title: AreaJam Tinder for Musicians Short
ctaTagline: Find your tribe. Match with musicians today.

scenes.headline: It's like Tinder — for local musicians
scenes.narration: Think of it like Tinder for musicians, except instead of small talk you're hearing real local players right on the card.

scenes.headline: Swipe left to pass, swipe right to jam
scenes.narration: Swipe left to pass, swipe right to send a jam invite, and hear linked YouTube or Instagram clips before you ever message.

scenes.headline: Pick your city & player type in one tap
scenes.subline: Any US metro or start your own town
scenes.narration: Pick your city, filter straight to drummers, guitarists, synth players, or producers, and browse free with zero sign-up.

scenes.headline: Scroll rigs, clips & vibe before you jam
scenes.subline: Link your YouTube handle in 60 seconds
scenes.narration: Open any full profile to watch live synth or studio takes, check their gear locker, and chat one-on-one once you match.

scenes.headline: Find your tribe. Match with musicians today.
scenes.narration: Try it free at areajam dot com, and drop your city and what you play in the comments.
